title: Three Rivers Hideaway
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Conveniently located 3.5 miles from the Foothills Entrance (Hwy. 198) to Sequoia National Park and 5 miles from Lake Kaweah. Three Rivers Hideaway is a quiet park on the banks of the Kaweah River in Three Rivers, California.
